bull_case: Further margin expansion is possible, but that is compounder execution rather than turnaround recovery.
bear_case: A semiconductor downcycle would create cyclicality, but the current starting point is not a trough.
thesis: TSM is not a turnaround. The relevant questions are durability, capital efficiency and valuation, not recovery from distress.

evidence.claim: FY2025 revenue grew 31.6% and gross margin reached 59.9%.
2Q26 gross margin was 67.7% and operating margin 60.3%.

counterevidence: Overseas fabs carry structurally higher costs; customer concentration and Taiwan/export-control tail risks remain material.
unknowns: AI/HPC demand duration beyond the current capacity-constrained cycle
falsifiers: A sustained loss of leading-edge share, repeated yield delays, or owner FCF/share stagnation despite rising capex would weaken the thesis.

key_kpis.name: owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: sustained growth through the capex cycle

next_checks: 3Q26 results, N2 ramp, CoWoS/advanced packaging capacity, overseas-fab margin, top-customer concentration

subscores.rationale: TSM is already at record/high margins and growth; this is not a trough recovery.
No distressed restructuring or balance-sheet repair is central to the thesis.
Earnings are above-cycle/expanding rather than depressed.
N2/A16 and capacity milestones are growth catalysts, not turnaround milestones.

uncertainties.rationale: AI-cycle duration, overseas economics and geopolitical/customer concentration remain material uncertainties.
